# CA Plastics Research Atlas

> A static, independent atlas of plastic-related research connected to California. It lists the researchers, institutions and works behind that research, built from public bibliographic data (OpenAlex) and public funding and monitoring sources.

Independent research atlas; profiles are generated from public bibliographic data.

## Main pages

- [Atlas home](https://plastiverse.live/): overview, search and tabs
- [Interactive app](https://plastiverse.live/app/): experts, institutions, funding, monitoring, policy, resources and glossary
- [Evidence](https://plastiverse.live/app/evidence): publication and evidence views
- [Experts](https://plastiverse.live/app/experts): California-connected plastics researchers
- [Institutions](https://plastiverse.live/app/institutions): institutions with California-connected plastics research
- [Funding](https://plastiverse.live/app/funding): grants and awards
- [Monitoring](https://plastiverse.live/app/monitoring): monitoring sources
- [Policy](https://plastiverse.live/app/policy): policy context
- [Resources](https://plastiverse.live/app/resources): downloads and data resources
- [Glossary](https://plastiverse.live/app/glossary): terms used in the Atlas
- [About](https://plastiverse.live/app/about): method, scope and limitations
- [Sitemap](https://plastiverse.live/sitemap.xml): index of all static pages

## Entity pages (static, one per expert or institution)

- Expert profiles: https://plastiverse.live/experts/<OpenAlex author ID>/
- Institution profiles: https://plastiverse.live/institutions/<institution ID>/

## Data and licence

- Data: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Code: MIT
- Archived release and citable DOI (concept, always resolves to the latest release): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24124016
